scope: Byte-verified full-text supplementary-source screen for the PNNL human-plasma nanoparticle-corona study. The source is retained as an analysis-only candidate because the public article and downloadable supplement do not establish a redistributable data licence and the source has insufficient overlap with the frozen R3 target universe.

article.title: Quantitative proteomics analysis of adsorbed plasma proteins classifies nanoparticles with different surface properties and size

source_asset.acquisition_method: official PMC supplementary endpoint with the endpoint's proof-of-work cookie

table_contract.design: six polystyrene nanoparticle size/surface conditions crossed with four exposure times
table_contract.source_defined_unit: individually processed condition/time sample; article cautions that time-point samples are process replicates rather than independent biological replicates

compatibility_probe.missingness_policy: No imputation; blank source cells remain non-rank-eligible. The source's raw relative-abundance scale is not pooled with another study.

reasons: The source has only 2 direct accessions in the frozen 99-protein R3 target universe; no measurement column reaches the predeclared ten-positive-target threshold.
The downloadable supplement has no verified redistributable data licence; the article's public full-text availability is not a licence grant for the spreadsheet.
The paper reports process/condition replicates and does not provide donor-level independent biological units suitable for replacing the 141-subject cohort.
Changing the target universe or minimum coverage after inspecting this source would be a post hoc protocol change and is prohibited.
decision.eligible_future_role: A separately preregistered, non-public, analysis-only technical transfer experiment could use the source after a rights review and a new endpoint/feature-generalization protocol; it cannot be labelled independent biological validation.

claim_boundary: This record proves that a real full-text human-plasma dataset was located, downloaded and structurally screened. It does not create an independent validation, protected lockbox, no-author reproduction, public data release, DOI or submission-ready result.
